risk_if_not_implemented: Without Configuration Management Program, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may operate with insecure, unauthorized or drifted configurations that expand the attack surface. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Change Management Program
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of a change management program.
compensating_control_1.justification: Change Management Program (CHG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Configuration Management Program (CFG-02) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Vulnerability & Patch Management Program (VPMP)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation and monitoring of risk-based vulnerability management capabilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Vulnerability & Patch Management Program (VPMP) (VPM-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Configuration Management Program (CFG-02) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
